name: eSIM
description: Windows MDM settings in the eSIM category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Auto Enable
properties.description: Indicates whether the discovered profile must be enabled automatically after install. This must be set by the MDM when the ServerName subtree is created.

properties.name: Display Local UI
properties.description: Determines whether the local user interface of the LUI is available (true if available, false otherwise). Initially populated by the LPA when the eUICC tree is created, can be queried and changed by the MDM server.

properties.name: Download Servers
properties.description: Node representing the discovery operation for a server name. The node name is the fully qualified domain name of the SM-DP+ server that will be used for profile discovery. Creation of this subtree triggers a discovery request.

properties.name: eSIM
properties.description: Represents information associated with an eUICC. There is one subtree for each known eUICC, created by the Local Profile Assistant (LPA) when the eUICC is first seen. The node name is the eUICC ID (EID). The node name "Default" represents the currently active eUICC.

properties.name: ICCID
properties.description: Node representing an enterprise-owned eUICC profile. The node name is the ICCID of the profile (which is a unique identifier). Creation of this subtree triggers an AddProfile request by the LPA (which installs the profile on the eUICC). Removal of this subtree triggers the LPA to delete the profile (if resident on the eUICC).

properties.name: Is Discovery Server
properties.description: Indicates whether the server is a discovery server or if it is used for bulk download. A discovery server is used every time a user requests a profile discovery operation. Optional, default value is false.

properties.name: Is Enabled
properties.description: Indicates whether this eSIM profile is enabled. Can be set by both the MDM and the CSP.

properties.name: Matching ID
properties.description: Matching ID (activation code token) for profile download. Must be set by the MDM when the ICCID subtree is created.

properties.name: Maximum Attempts (Windows Insiders only)
properties.description:
How many times profile download should be attempted before giving up. A value of 0 indicates unlimited retry attempts. When a value is not specified, it defaults to 50, which is equivalent to about a month of retry attempts.
 This setting is only available to Windows Insiders

properties.name: Server Name
properties.description: Fully qualified domain name of the SM-DP+ that can download this profile. Must be set by the MDM when the ICCID subtree is created.
